issues.what: Side and front rows are visually identical across phase; mesh rotation is only readable through the iso cap ports. meta.moving is empty because centroid travel is ~0.

motion_reads_as: Figure-eight body and cap stay put while red and green flashes in the cap ports walk around the holes, showing the two internal gears turning in place.
notes: Port flashes repeat every 180 deg (0~180, 60~240, 120~300), consistent with an even-tooth gear spinning. Housing never drifts. Last column continues the port walk.
